blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — Anti-narcotics operatives seized P408,000 worth of suspected shabu and arrested a 27-year-old “high-value individual” during a pre-dawn buy-bust operation in Barangay Nazareth here, the Police Regional Office-10 (PRO-10) said. In a press advisory, PRO-10 identified the suspect only by the alias “Mego,” a resident of Pinikitan in Barangay Camaman-an, this city. Authorities confiscated approximately 60 grams of suspected shabu from the suspect during the sting operation at the Rotonda area in Barangay Nazareth at 1:26 a.m. on Tuesday.
